name: Martha
bio: Martha welcomed Jesus into her house in a village and busied herself serving, while her sister Mary sat at Jesus's feet listening to him. When Martha complained that Mary had left her to serve alone, Jesus gently told her that Mary had chosen the one necessary thing, which would not be taken from her (Luke 10:38-42). Her further role, alongside her sister and brother Lazarus, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
